seo.description: OrganixEvents creates, organises and hosts sport and adventure experiences — private snowcat freeride in North Macedonia, Arctic ski trips, the Alps, summer camps and custom adventures.

title: Built in the mountains.
Made for adventure.
about.text: Organix is Bryan and Stéphane. Stéphane has been at the heart of Organix — and of North Macedonia — for around fifteen years. Bryan spent more than a decade in international ski cross with the Swiss team. Together they bought a snowcat, brought it to North Macedonia and built a local operation with partners on the ground.
